questions.questionText: Which of the following is a CSS property that can be used to set the background color of a React component?
questions.explanation: The background-color property sets the background color of an element (written as backgroundColor in React inline styles).

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is a benefit of using JSX in React?
options: JSX is faster than traditional HTML templates
JSX provides better code organization and readability
JSX is easier to learn than HTML and CSS
JSX is more compatible with older Web browsers
questions.correctAnswer: JSX provides better code organization and readability
questions.explanation: JSX lets you write markup alongside component logic, improving code organization and readability.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is an example of a synthetic event in ReactJS?
questions.explanation: onClick, onChange and onBlur are all React SyntheticEvents, a cross-browser wrapper around native browser events.

questions.questionText: Which CSS property is used to adjust the opacity of a React component?
questions.explanation: The opacity property sets the transparency level of an element, from 0 (fully transparent) to 1 (fully opaque).

questions.questionText: What is the purpose of the "key" attribute in ReactJS?
options: To specify the type of element being rendered.
To provide a unique identifier for a list of elements.
To control the behavior of a component.
questions.correctAnswer: To provide a unique identifier for a list of elements.
questions.explanation: Keys give list items a stable identity so React can efficiently determine which items changed, were added or removed.

questions.questionText: Which of the following methods can be used to handle mouse events in a React component?
questions.explanation: onMouseEnter, onMouseLeave, onMouseDown and onMouseUp are all React mouse event handlers.

questions.questionText: What is the purpose of user visual hierarchy in UI?
options: To create a visually pleasing interface with attractive colors and typography.
To guide users' attention and prioritize information based on importance.
To ensure consistent spacing and alignment of UI elements.
To optimize the UI for different screen sizes and resolutions.
questions.correctAnswer: To guide users' attention and prioritize information based on importance.
questions.explanation: Visual hierarchy arranges elements so users notice the most important information first.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is an Informational component?
questions.explanation: A progress bar conveys information (task progress). Checkbox and radio button are input controls; pagination is a navigational component.

questions.questionText: What is Material Design?
options: A design language designed by Google
A programming language for Web development
questions.correctAnswer: A design language designed by Google
questions.explanation: Material Design is a design language developed by Google in 2014; Material UI implements it for React.

questions.questionText: Which of the following commands is used to find how documents are distributed amongst the shards?
questions.explanation: db.collection.getShardDistribution() prints data and document distribution statistics for a sharded collection across its shards.

questions.questionText: Which of the following command can be used to run under admin database, irrespective of the database currently in use?
questions.explanation: db.adminCommand() always runs the command against the admin database, regardless of the database currently selected.

questions.questionText: Sharding is ______.
options: Storing all the data in same server
Storing all the data in multiple servers
Storing part of the data in one server
Indexing and storing data across servers
questions.correctAnswer: Storing all the data in multiple servers
questions.explanation: Sharding distributes (horizontally partitions) the full data set across multiple servers (shards) to support large data sets and high throughput.

questions.questionText: MongoDB defines indexes at the ______ level.
questions.explanation: MongoDB defines indexes at the collection level and supports indexes on any field or sub-field of the documents.

questions.questionText: Which of the following method is used to select the first document in MongoDB using Python?
questions.explanation: In PyMongo, collection.find_one() returns the first document that matches the query (or the first document in the collection if no filter is given).

questions.questionText: Which of the following tools helps you view the statistics of inserts and updates in MongoDB?
questions.explanation: mongostat provides a quick overview of a running mongod/mongos, showing counts of inserts, queries, updates, deletes and more per second.

questions.questionText: Which of the following commands is used to direct a query to the shard server?
questions.explanation: mongos is the query router for a sharded cluster; it routes client queries to the appropriate shard(s).

questions.questionText: Which of the following is the name given to the index which exists in every MongoDB collection and prevents duplication of data?
questions.explanation: Every collection has a default unique index on the _id field, which prevents inserting two documents with the same _id value.

questions.questionText: If the _id field in Default_id is not defined, who creates it?
questions.explanation: If a document is inserted without an _id field, the MongoDB language driver automatically generates an ObjectId for it.

questions.questionText: A MongoDB aggregation pipeline can have ______ number of stages.
questions.explanation: An aggregation pipeline consists of one or more stages, and you can chain any number of stages to process documents.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is an Input control?
questions.explanation: A button is an input control; card, menu and snackbar are not.

questions.questionText: The design token name that starts with md.sys is a ______.
questions.explanation: Tokens starting with md.sys are system tokens (md.ref are reference tokens).

questions.questionText: Which component allows swift navigation between different parts of an application?
questions.explanation: Navigational components (menus, tabs, drawers) allow movement between parts of an app.

questions.questionText: Which of the following stages is usually the last stage of an aggregation pipeline?
questions.explanation: $out writes the pipeline results to a collection and must be the last stage.

questions.questionText: Which of the following tools is used to bring the JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) files into MongoDB server?
questions.explanation: mongoimport imports JSON, CSV or TSV data into MongoDB.

questions.questionText: Which of the following command can be used to change the field name in a document?
questions.explanation: $rename changes the name of a field.

questions.questionText: Which Graphical User Interface (GUI) tool is used to connect to MongoDB?
questions.explanation: MongoDB Compass is the official GUI for MongoDB.

questions.questionText: An aggregation pipeline stage takes its input from the ______ stage.
questions.explanation: Each stage receives the output of the previous stage.

questions.questionText: After how many days of inactiveness does the Atlas initiate a pause on the clusters?
questions.explanation: Atlas pauses inactive clusters after 60 days of inactivity.

questions.questionText: What is Material Design used for?
questions.explanation: Material Design is a design system by Google that provides guidelines and components to design user friendly products.

questions.questionText: Material design tokens are created to store the value of ______ in style library.
questions.explanation: Design tokens are named entities that store style values (colors, typography, shape, etc.) in a style library.

questions.questionText: In Material design, what does the term 'elevation' refer to?
options: The vertical position of an element on the screen
Leaving the ground or leaving the surface
The degree of opacity applied to a background color
The spacing between elements in a layout
questions.correctAnswer: Leaving the ground or leaving the surface
questions.explanation: Elevation is the relative distance of a surface from another along the z-axis, i.e. how far it rises (leaves) the surface beneath it.

questions.questionText: You are designing a fitness tracking app that offers different modes for various activities, such as running, cycling, and swimming. Each mode should have a distinct color scheme to provide a visual differentiation. Which UI design aspect focuses on defining a set of colors and their combinations to create a consistent and visually appealing user interface?
questions.explanation: A color system defines the palette and color combinations used to create a consistent, visually appealing UI.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is required to create a Figma account?
questions.explanation: A Figma account can be created using an email address and password.

questions.questionText: What is Breadcrumb in UI design?
options: A visual representation of a hierarchical navigation path
A type of input control for selecting multiple options
A form of progress indicator in multi-step processes
A design element for displaying alerts or notifications
questions.correctAnswer: A visual representation of a hierarchical navigation path
questions.explanation: Breadcrumbs show the user's location within a site's hierarchy and allow navigation back to parent pages.

questions.questionText: You are designing a file upload feature for a cloud storage application. Users should be able to see the progress of their file upload. Which UI component would be most suitable to visually display the upload progress in this scenario?
questions.explanation: Progress bars visually indicate how much of a task, such as a file upload, has been completed.

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements is true about UI design language?
options: UI design is about how the product's interfaces look and function
End goal of UI design is to make the user's interaction as simple and efficient
It is specific to digital experiences
questions.explanation: All the listed statements correctly describe UI design.

questions.questionText: Material design reference token stores the value of ______ in the style library.
questions.explanation: Reference tokens (md.ref.*) hold the raw reference style values available in the style library.

questions.questionText: What is the recommended frequency for conducting E2E tests in a MERN stack application?
options: Only during the initial development phase
After implementing significant modifications or updates
questions.correctAnswer: After implementing significant modifications or updates
questions.explanation: End-to-end (E2E) tests should be run after implementing significant modifications or updates to ensure critical user flows continue working properly.

questions.questionText: Which directory is dedicated to housing reusable React components in the project structure?
questions.explanation: The components/ directory is conventionally dedicated to storing reusable React UI components.

questions.questionText: In MERN, ______ library facilitates client-side routing, enabling navigation within the app without full page reloads.
questions.explanation: React Router enables client-side routing in React and MERN applications, allowing navigation between views without full page reloads.

questions.questionText: Explain the significance of the viewport meta tag in achieving responsive design.
options: It regulates the width and scaling of the viewport in HTML
It defines database connections and schemas
questions.correctAnswer: It regulates the width and scaling of the viewport in HTML
questions.explanation: The viewport meta tag tells the browser how to control the page width and scaling on different device screens for responsive design.

questions.questionText: ______ is commonly used for server-side operations in full-stack development.
questions.explanation: JavaScript (via Node.js in the MERN stack) is commonly used for server-side operations in full-stack web development.

questions.questionText: In Express.js, which parameter serves as the error handler in personalized middleware functions for error handling?
questions.explanation: Express error-handling middleware takes four parameters (err, req, res, next), where err is the first parameter representing the error.

questions.questionText: What role does the Long Term Support (LTS) edition play in the Node.js installation process?
options: Ensures stability with a stable version
Provides support for the latest features
questions.correctAnswer: Ensures stability with a stable version
questions.explanation: The Node.js LTS (Long Term Support) edition provides a stable, well-tested version with long-term security and maintenance support.

questions.questionText: What is the key strength of Node.js in handling scalable and real-time applications?
questions.explanation: Node.js excels at scalable, real-time applications because of its non-blocking, asynchronous operations and event-driven architecture.

questions.questionText: Which React-based framework provides Server-Side Rendering (SSR) and Static Site Generation (SSG) capabilities for better Search Engine Optimization (SEO) and performance?
questions.explanation: Next.js is a React-based framework that supports both Server-Side Rendering (SSR) and Static Site Generation (SSG) for better SEO and performance.

questions.questionText: Axios simplifies the process of making HTTP requests within ______ and Web browsers in the context of Web development.
questions.explanation: Axios is a promise-based HTTP client that works seamlessly in both Node.js and Web browsers.

questions.questionText: What is the role of Web servers in full stack development?
questions.explanation: Web servers handle incoming client HTTP requests and return appropriate responses, serving static files or routing requests to backend logic.

questions.questionText: Which JavaScript library is commonly used for making HTTP requests in ReactJS components?
questions.explanation: Axios is a popular JavaScript library commonly used to make HTTP requests in ReactJS components (while Fetch API is a built-in browser API).

questions.questionText: What is the primary advantage of token-based authentication in MERN applications?
questions.explanation: Token-based authentication (like JWT) is stateless, scalable, and well-suited for RESTful APIs in MERN applications.

questions.questionText: What is the initial step in establishing a robust back end server in full stack development?
questions.explanation: Selecting the appropriate back-end technology stack is the foundational first step before setting up the environment, configuring databases, and designing APIs.

questions.questionText: How does the Fetch API differ from Axios in ReactJS applications?
options: Fetch API is a more flexible alternative to traditional XMLHttpRequest, and Axios is a popular library for making HTTP requests
Fetch API is specific to React, while Axios is a general-purpose library
Axios is used for server-side requests, and Fetch API is for client-side requests
Axios is built into React, while Fetch API needs to be installed separately
questions.correctAnswer: Fetch API is a more flexible alternative to traditional XMLHttpRequest, and Axios is a popular library for making HTTP requests
questions.explanation: Fetch API is a modern built-in browser interface replacing XMLHttpRequest, whereas Axios is a third-party library for making HTTP requests.

questions.questionText: What is the purpose of UI Design language?
options: To establish a consistent visual style across different platforms and devices.
To optimize Website performance and loading speed.
To provide guidelines for coding and programming UI elements.
To automate the design process and generate UI layouts.
questions.correctAnswer: To establish a consistent visual style across different platforms and devices.
questions.explanation: A UI design language defines visual principles, patterns, and components to maintain a consistent look and feel across different platforms and devices.

questions.questionText: What are the roles and responsibilities of a UI Designer?
options: Create the visual hierarchy in design
Conduct user testing for user feedback to refine designs
questions.explanation: A UI Designer creates screens, establishes visual hierarchy in the interface, and conducts user testing to gather feedback and refine designs.

questions.questionText: You are designing a product showcase section for an e-commerce Website. You want to display multiple product images in a visually appealing and interactive way, allowing users to navigate through them. Which UI component would be most suitable to showcase multiple product images with interactive navigation?
questions.explanation: Carousels display multiple images or slides in an interactive, visually appealing container that users can browse using arrows, indicators, or swipe gestures.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is true about Figma?
options: Figma is a programming language for UI design
Figma is used for creating 3D models and animations
Figma helps UI teams to build components together
Figma is only available for Windows operating system
questions.correctAnswer: Figma helps UI teams to build components together
questions.explanation: Figma is a collaborative, cloud-based UI/UX design tool that enables teams to design interfaces and build reusable component libraries together in real time.

questions.questionText: What is pagination in context of UI?
options: The process of organizing content into sections or categories.
The technique of loading content dynamically as the user scrolls.
The method of breaking long content into multiple pages or screens.
The practice of designing visually appealing page layouts.
questions.correctAnswer: The method of breaking long content into multiple pages or screens.
questions.explanation: Pagination divides large lists or long content into separate numbered pages or screens so users can navigate through items easily.

questions.questionText: ____ is data-driven, ____ is looks-driven.
questions.explanation: UX (User Experience) is data-driven—focusing on user research, usability, and behavior—whereas UI (User Interface) is looks-driven, focusing on visual presentation and aesthetics.

questions.questionText: You are designing a Website for an e-commerce platform that sells various products. Users should be able to browse different categories and easily navigate between product pages. Which navigational component would be most appropriate to use in this scenario?
questions.explanation: A drop-down menu allows e-commerce users to browse product categories and subcategories from the navigation bar and easily move between product pages.

questions.questionText: What are the two additional colors that Material Design allows when creating a color system using Figma?
questions.explanation: Beyond primary, secondary, and neutral tones, Material Design's color system in Figma allows adding semantic success and error colors to communicate status and feedback.

questions.questionText: What is the purpose of Material design Grid system?
questions.explanation: Material Design's responsive layout grid adapts to different screen sizes and orientations to create consistent, responsive layouts.
